scripts.quickstart: npm run prepare:irpkg -- examples/quickstart.virpkg.json && node scripts/packages/quickstart-url.mjs

scripts.build:demo: lake build Vir && npm run probe:upstream
scripts.build:local-artifact: npm run build:demo:release && npm run prepare:pages && npm run package:local-artifact
scripts.build:sdk-artifact: npm run build:demo:release && npm run package:sdk-artifact

scripts.build:frontier-size-site: npm run analyze:frontier-size -- --plan scripts/analysis/frontier-size-plan.json --surface-links web/dist/surface/data/size-links.json --output-prefix build/frontier-size-costs/site
scripts.build:analysis-site: npm run build:surface-site && npm run build:frontier-size-site && npm run render:surface -- build/vir-surface/lean-libraries.json web/dist/surface --frontier-costs build/frontier-size-costs/site.json && npm run build:size-site -- --surface-links web/dist/surface/data/size-links.json --frontier-costs build/frontier-size-costs/site.json

scripts.test:tutorials: lake build VirInfoview Vir.Examples.Style && lake env lean examples/tutorials/ReactCounter.lean && lake env lean examples/tutorials/ReactProofWidgetHello.lean
scripts.test:site: npm run build:site && npm run test:pages
scripts.test:infoview: lake build VirInfoview VirInfoviewFixtures && npm run check:infoview-bundle && lake env lean fixtures/infoview/Smoke.lean && node tests/infoview-widget.mjs
scripts.test:upstream: npm run build:demo && npm run test:upstream:no-build
